title: Nightcord at 25:00 Chapter1 Episode2 Midnight Meet-Up

rows.Speaker: Social Media Post
rows.Line: <Hey! Anyone heard N25's new song yet?>

rows.Speaker: Social Media Post
rows.Line: <It's a music group that produces their own songs and MVs. You've never heard of them? Well, try one of their songs and tell me what you think!>

rows.Speaker: Social Media Post
rows.Line: <Are they that good? I guess I'll check them out since I don't have anything to do right now anyway.>

rows.Speaker: Social Media Post
rows.Line: <I know, right? It's like the song stabs deep into you and gouges out all the feels!>

rows.Speaker: Social Media Post
rows.Line: <Yeah. It's almost scary how hard it hits.>

rows.Speaker: Social Media Post
rows.Line: <The group that made this is called N25, you said? What're they like?>

rows.Speaker: Social Media Post
rows.Line: <That's the thing. No one really knows. We know there are four members, but everything else is shrouded in mystery. That's part of their allure, I guess!>

rows.Speaker: Social Media Post
rows.Line: <I see. I guess I'll keep them on my playlist, then. N25 is such a strange name, though.>

rows.Speaker: Social Media Post
rows.Line: <Oh, that's just what everyone calls them. Their real group name is...>
There needs to be a sharper sound here.
Hello? Yes, this is Kanade. Is something wrong, Grandma?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, I'm doing fine living by myself.
Yes, I make sure I visit him at the hospital too.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
.....
When did it get so late?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I'd better eat something.
There should be a bunch of instant noodles around here somewhere...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: There they are. Is this all the food left in the house? I'd better buy some more soon...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll look over the new song while I wait.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That reminds me. Didn't someone post a new song yesterday? I should give it a listen.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hmm. Miku's the singer? Looks like it changes to 3/4 here...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: My noodles should be ready by now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Alright, one last push... I want to finish this today.

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line:
<Sorry I'm late, everyone.
Have you been waiting long?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
It's okay—oh, right.
I left my mic muted.

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <It's okay. We were all just working on our own parts as usual.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Hey, Yuki! You're back! How was school?>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Thanks for holding the fort. Sorry, club activities took way longer than usual today. I tried to get home as soon as I could.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <No worries. You already told us yesterday that you'd be late.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line:
<K, you finally unmuted your mic, huh?
How's your work coming along?>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <More or less done, but I want to give it another listen later.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Yawn... I'm so sleepy. Oh, Yuki's back.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line:
<Yep. Hey there.
How far has everyone gotten today?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <I need a bit more time to finish it, though.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Amia's doing the first storyboard draft of the MV.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <I have a really cute video planned♪>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <And I just finished the rough draft of our new song. Would you give it a listen, Yuki? I'd like your opinion.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Oh, K! I just finished the storyboards for the MV. I'll send the file your way now.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Nightcord sure makes all this stuff super easy♪ All the other chat apps make it so difficult to share files.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <I guess. Ugh, why's it still so bright outside? It's already evening!>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Probably because you've been sleeping too much. I bet you've been asleep ever since we stopped working yesterday, haven't you?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <I didn't sleep that much. I couldn't stop working on the illustration once I started, so I didn't get to sleep until about nine this morning.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Enanan, you're always such a night owl.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<I work better at night, that's all.
Besides, it's easier to focus when it's quiet.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <I mean I totally get it, but all-nighters are really not cool. It's gotta be bad for your skin!>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Isn't it about time for you to go to school, Enanan? Or does your part-time course allow you to be late?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Oh, shoot! I'll get back on Nightcord after school!>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line:
<I'm going back to working on my stuff too.
I just found this really nice effect that I wanna try♪>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <I'll be mixing the next song to be posted, then I'll listen to the draft version K made and start thinking about the best way to arrange it.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line:
<Okay. I'll get back to work too.
I'll look at it when I'm done.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <At the usual time and place, then?>
